capabilities: Lock the vault behind a password-protected lockscreen
Encrypt all .md files on disk with AES-GCM and decrypt on unlock
Auto-lock the vault after a configurable idle period
Customize lockscreen background, greeting text, and sizing
Rate password strength with zxcvbn feedback
extras: Not yet approved for the Community Plugins store; manual installation is documented. Warns that forgotten passwords with note encryption enabled cause permanent, unrecoverable data loss and urges regular vault backups.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as plain files with no built-in way to lock the vault or encrypt note contents against unauthorized access.
summary: Lockscreen plugin that locks the vault behind a master password and can optionally encrypt every note on disk with AES-GCM.
